narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational warning and PSA (Public Service Announcement) about sophisticated LINE messaging scams. The creator uses a personal storytelling format to detail how a scammer impersonated her friend using the same name and profile picture to send phishing links disguised as product recommendations. It emphasizes vigilance against online identity theft.
